The content SEO audit found that Inc5 pages need clearer H1 handling, useful headings, stronger source-backed content, media support, semantic tables and lists, image alt text, unique title and meta descriptions, structured data matching visible content, and improved content refresh workflows.

Inc5 has a public store locator. Blog content may mention online shopping and store discovery, but city-specific availability should not be claimed without store-level evidence.
